evals.prompt: my docker container keeps crashing with 'OOMKilled' — can you fix it
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers after applying the fix. Captures git diff, calls generate_capsule(), shows confidence + redactions, asks user to confirm posting, calls post_to_stack_overflow().

assertions.description: Runs git diff to capture the fix before calling generate_capsule
Calls generate_capsule() MCP tool with problem, root_cause, fix, and source=ai-assisted
Shows the confidence rating to the user before posting
Asks user to confirm before calling post_to_stack_overflow

evals.prompt: fix this — TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map') at line 42
evals.expected_output: After fixing the TypeError, skill auto-triggers. Extracts the error message as the 'error' field, captures diff, generates capsule, reviews with user, posts.

assertions.description: Runs git diff to capture the fix
Passes the original TypeError as the error field to generate_capsule
Does not call post_to_stack_overflow without user confirmation

evals.prompt: add a dark mode toggle to the settings page
evals.expected_output: Skill does NOT trigger — this is a new feature request, not a bug fix. No generate_capsule call.

assertions.description: Does not call generate_capsule() — this is a feature, not a bug fix

evals.prompt: my github actions workflow is failing with 'npm ERR! code ENOENT' — help
evals.expected_output: After fixing the CI failure, skill triggers. Captures diff, sets source=ai-assisted, detects github-actions tag, generates capsule, posts.

assertions.description: Runs git diff to capture the fix
Generated capsule includes github-actions in tags
